name: Dematerialisation Lever
real: The main take-off lever (dematerialisation circuit); thrown to send the TARDIS into the vortex.
does: Starts a jump: dematerialise here, land at the destination (with the handbrake off).

name: Handbrake
real: The handbrake (parking brake), famously left on by the Doctor so the TARDIS groans on landing.
does: On: no jump or flight can start. Off: the dematerialisation lever and thrusters work.

name: Exterior Phase Key
real: The TARDIS key in its console lock (the key that starts or locks the ship in several eras).
does: Turned on, it frees the exterior: pull the Phase Lever to make the box an entity, or back to a block.

name: Phase Lever
real: A guarded secondary lever, after the materialisation and stabiliser levers on the classic consoles.
does: With the key turned: block -> entity (stays a materialised box) or entity -> block where it rests.

name: Thrusters
real: The anti-grav / stabiliser engines; a guarded rocker like a cockpit master switch.
does: On: anti-grav holds the box still in the air (hovering). Off: it is a physics object and falls.

name: Flight Yoke
real: The flight / navigation stick (the 'space-time throttle' joystick of later consoles).
does: Takes the pressing crew member into third-person piloting; again (or Shift) stops piloting.

name: Helmic Regulator
real: Sets the TARDIS's 'helmic' balance in flight; a big rotary regulator on many consoles.
does: Four settings, one per click: flight speed (slow, cruise, fast, boost).

name: Fast Return Switch
real: The fast return switch: sends the TARDIS back to where it last came from.
does: Pressed: the next jump goes back to the last landing spot.

name: Vector Tracker
real: Tracks the flight vector through the vortex; drawn here as a glowing trackball.
does: Spins when used: fine-tunes the landing spot by one block in the facing direction.

name: Coordinate Wheels
real: The spatial co-ordinate controls; three thumbwheels as on the old navigation panels.
does: Each wheel moves the course by the step size along X, Y or Z (8 detents per turn).

name: Directional Pointer
real: Sets which way the TARDIS faces when it lands (the directional unit).
does: Each click turns the needle 45 degrees; the box lands facing that way (8 directions).

name: Stabilisers
real: The blue stabilisers the Doctor leaves off for a bumpier, 'more fun' flight.
does: Left: steadies flight (less shake, slower turns). Right: steadies landings (no drift on touchdown).

name: Space-Time Throttle
real: The space-time throttle: how hard the TARDIS pushes through the vortex.
does: Four notches: how much charge a jump spends to land closer to the aimed spot.

name: Telepathic Circuits
real: The telepathic interface: put a hand on it and think of where to go.
does: Hand on it (click): picks the destination you last looked at on the map; lights while set.

name: Randomiser
real: The randomiser, fitted to hide the TARDIS from the Black Guardian: it picks the next landing by chance.
does: Spins the die: the next jump goes to a random open destination.

name: Door Control
real: The door control (a crank or lever opening the doors from the console).
does: Half a turn opens the doors, half a turn closes them (also locks them while flying).

name: Coordinate Lever
real: 1.7.10: the X/Y/Z levers (ids 10-13, 20-23, 30-33): staple levers swinging 140 degrees; the later levers make bigger changes.
does: Moves the course along one axis by its own amount (small to huge, set per lever in data).

name: Valve Wheel
real: 1.7.10: the X/Z coordinate wheels and the facing wheel (ids 3, 14, 15, 24, 25): a square valve wheel that turns a full circle.
does: Each click turns it an eighth; eight make one full turn of the setting it drives.

name: Flight Take-off Lever
real: 1.7.10: the flight take-off lever (id 42), the 'special lever' that swings sideways 140 degrees.
does: The classic way to start a coordinated flight (kept beside the dematerialisation lever).

name: Push Switch
real: 1.7.10: push switches (stabilise 56, landing pad 55, save/load 900, ...): a rod pushed in, it stays in.
does: On/off for whatever it is set to in data (stabilisers, landing pad, save/load mode).

name: Flight Control Button
real: 1.7.10: flight controls (id 40 and the button bank): 'press these when they glow during flight'; the button rises while it waits.
does: During a jump it lights and rises; press it in time or the flight drifts (stabilisers skip this).

name: Gauge
real: 1.7.10: the energy, rooms, speed, XP and shields gauges (ids 0, 1, 2, 8, 9): a display with a needle sweeping 180 degrees.
does: Shows one value from 0 to full (charge, rooms used, speed, shields), set in data; not clicked.

name: Twin Gauge
real: 1.7.10: the XP and shields gauges sat as a pair below the other three.
does: Two values side by side (e.g. shields and hull), each needle 0 to full.

name: Scanner Screen
real: 1.7.10: the coordinate guesser (id 100) and scanner (id 54) screens: a framed screen set into the panel.
does: Click to switch it on/off; shows the coordinate guess or the scanner view (text drawn by the renderer).

name: Schematic Chooser
real: 1.7.10: the schema chooser (ids 50, 51, 57, 58 and display 52): a long display with buttons to page categories and rooms.
does: Pages through the rooms that can be added (category and room), as the old console did.

name: Sonic Screwdriver Holder
real: 1.7.10: the screwdriver holder (id 6) and generator button (id 5): a socket holding the sonic.
does: Click to take or put back the sonic screwdriver; it rises out of the socket when ready.

name: Console Lamp
real: 1.7.10: the console lights (LightModel / TardisLightModel): flat lamps that glow with a state.
does: Lights for whatever it is tied to in data (in flight, low charge, door open...).

name: Memory Bank
real: 1.7.10: the 20 save/load buttons on the left panel (ids 1000-1019) with the save/load switch.
does: Each button is a saved location: press to load it, or save to it in save mode.

name: Coordinated Flight Lever
real: 1.7.10: the uncoordinated flight lever: out = drifting mode, in = coordinated flight mode.
does: Out: the TARDIS drifts (free roaming flight). In: coordinated flight to the set destination.

name: Room Deleter
real: 1.7.10: the room deleter (id 901): right click then sneak right click deletes all rooms.
does: Two-step press (arm, then sneak-press) removes every added room; the frame lights while armed.

name: Speed Lever
real: 1.7.10: the speed lever (id 4) with the speed gauge beside it.
does: Five notches of flight speed; faster flights cost more charge.

name: Sub-Lever Bank
real: 1.7.10: the small levers round the panels (ids 1020-1029) for lesser functions.
does: Three small on/off switches for lesser functions (lights, alarms, shields), set in data.
